description: Synchronize all of your IDE settings across multiple devices.
configuration.title: config-gitee-sync
configuration.giteeSync.excludedExtensio:
Configure glob patterns for excluding IDE extensions from being synchronized. For example:
[
    "somepublisher.*",
    "KylinIDETeam.config-gitee-sync"
]
Now the extension `KylinIDETeam.config-gitee-sync` and all the extensions of the author `somepublisher` will no longer be synchronized.
configuration.giteeSync.excludedSettings:
Configure glob patterns for excluding IDE settings from being synchronized. For example:
[
    "editor.*",
    "workbench.colorTheme"
]
Now the setting `workbench.colorTheme` and all the settings of `editor` will no longer be synchronized.
configuration.giteeSync.extensions.autoU: Automatically update extensions during the synchronization.
configuration.giteeSync.pokaYokeThreshol:
Configure a threshold to enable Poka-Yoke (Mistake-Proofing).
Each time you start a synchronization, config-gitee-sync will display a confirm dialog if the changes between the local and remote setting exceed the threshold.
The default value is 10. To disable this feature, just change it to 0.
configuration.giteeSync.separateKeybindi:
Synchronize the `keybindings` separately for different operating systems.
You may disable it since the IDE has introduced the `Platform Specific Keybindings` from version 1.27. But please make sure you've already merged your keybindings before disabling this setting.
